description: Defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeAttendanceSummarySearchFilterParams' that extends 'AttendanceRecordSearchFilterParams', used for searching, filtering, and sorting employee attendance summaries in the OrangeHRM system. It sets default sorting to 'employee.lastName'.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceSummarySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering and sorting employee attendance summary search results, extending base filter parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object, sets default sort field to 'employee.lastName' and default sort order to ascending.
